name: DEBUGLOG
text:
#  define DEBUGLOG(l, ...) {                          \
        if ((g_debuglog_enable) && (l<=LZ4_DEBUG)) {  \
            fprintf(stderr, __FILE__  " %i: ", __LINE__); \
            fprintf(stderr, __VA_ARGS__);             \
            fprintf(stderr, " \n");                   \
    }   }
#else
